en.hook: $0.62 per mile for Class A drivers
en.body: You run regional with a Class A license and get paid $0.62 per mile. The job is 2500 miles. Plain pay, counted by the mile.

es.hook: $0.62 por milla para choferes Clase A
es.body: Manejas regional con licencia Clase A y te pagan $0.62 por milla. El trabajo es de 2500 millas. Pago claro, contado por milla.

en.body: This is regional driving for a Class A driver. You cover 2500 miles, and each one pays $0.62. Reach out and talk to dispatch.

es.body: Es trabajo regional para chofer Clase A. Recorres 2500 millas y cada una se paga a $0.62. Escríbenos y habla con despacho.

en.body: Here is the deal: 2500 miles at $0.62 per mile. Regional runs, Class A. If that works for you, send your info and we will talk.
